title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a thick pepper and tomato sauce, spiced with cumin and caraway. One pan, and the sauce keeps for days without the eggs.

steps.text: Cook the onion and red bell peppers in the olive oil until genuinely soft and beginning to catch.
steps.tip: This is where the sweetness comes from. Ten minutes is not enough.

steps.text: Add the garlic, cumin, caraway seed, and paprika and stir until fragrant.
Add the tinned tomatoes, season, and simmer until the sauce is thick enough to hold a channel when you drag a spoon through it.
Make six wells and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook until the whites are set and the yolks are still loose.
steps.tip: Pull it a minute early — the pan carries on cooking at the table.

steps.text: Scatter over the feta and parsley.
